description: This file contains end-to-end test functions for channel management commands in Mattermost's CLI, including listing, searching, creating, archiving, unarchiving, deleting, renaming, and moving channels, with permission and error handling scenarios.

methods.name: TestListChannelsCmdF
methods.description: Tests listing channels command with various user permissions and error scenarios.

methods.name: TestSearchChannelCmd
methods.description: Tests searching for channels, including non-existent, existing, and team-specific channels.

methods.name: TestCreateChannelCmd
methods.description: Tests creating channels with valid data, nonexistent teams, and invalid names.

methods.name: TestArchiveChannelsCmdF
methods.description: Tests archiving channels with permission checks and error handling.

methods.name: TestUnarchiveChannelsCmdF
methods.description: Tests unarchiving channels with permission checks and error handling.

methods.name: TestDeleteChannelsCmd
methods.description: Tests deleting channels with permission checks, config settings, and error scenarios.

methods.name: TestChannelRenameCmd
methods.description: Tests renaming channels, including permission restrictions and non-existent channels.

methods.name: TestMoveChannelCmd
methods.description: Tests moving channels between teams, including non-existent teams/channels and permission issues.
